snippet.title: Making a horror game about time loop
snippet.description:
A short devlog about making my new horror game - The Paper Loop. A game, where you play as a person, cought in a time loop, excactly 10 minutes before the disaster.

Work In Progress.

Follow me on X https://x.com/serious_voice
My games on itch https://danieloschepkov.itch.io/
